findings.body: This test uses a real database but calls creation, listing, and rendering functions directly. It never exercises the required running API and Playwright user flow. Its valid-snapshot assertions also remain true if the removed no-snapshot fallbacks are restored, so it does not detect that regression. Existing CLI coverage mocks the API (apps/core/test/unit/cli/memory-review-command.test.ts:15). Add regression-sensitive coverage through the required entry points and include it in the repository test command; forge.toml:6 invokes npm test, whose script at package.json:86 runs only unit and integration suites.

findings.body: The new assertions detect the removed legacy behavior, but they feed handcrafted events directly into SessionTypingTracker. This leaves the typing requirement proven only by a unit test, which the completion contract explicitly disallows. Add coverage through the running API, real database, and Playwright user flow that verifies observable typing behavior through actual event consumption. Wire that coverage into the repository test command: forge.toml:6 invokes npm test, and package.json:86 does not include the end-to-end suite.
